stem: A tray contains a mislabeled cell and visible contamination. What is the strongest immediate response?
choices: Relabel the cell from memory and continue.
Mix the affected cells into another tray.
Preserve identity boundaries, isolate/hold the affected material as required, document the observation and escalate under procedure.
Discard the entire lot without documentation.
rationale: Preserve identity boundaries, isolate/hold the affected material as required, document the observation and escalate under procedure.
